title: U.S. Airline Pricing, Demand, and Operational Quality, 2024
description: A curated relational release of 2024 domestic marketing-carrier flights and aggregated DB1B ticket-market sample records.

coverage.geography: Domestic U.S. scheduled passenger markets represented in the respective BTS reporting systems

join_keys.design_note: Flight operations and sampled ticket markets are not row-level joinable. Aggregate flights to carrier-route-quarter before joining to fare summaries. Marketing and ticketing carrier definitions may not be identical for every itinerary.

sources.name: Origin and Destination Survey DB1B Market

privacy.assessment: The federal public sources contain operational and aggregated ticket-market records, not passenger identities. Aircraft tail numbers are replaced with release-local keys.

license.attribution: Bureau of Transportation Statistics, U.S. Department of Transportation

artifacts.name: flights
artifacts.grain: One reported scheduled domestic marketing-carrier flight

artifacts.name: airports
artifacts.grain: One BTS airport identifier represented in 2024 flights

artifacts.name: route_quarter
artifacts.grain: One directional route, ticketing carrier, year, and quarter

artifacts.name: carrier_month
artifacts.grain: One marketing carrier and calendar month
